@graph.name: Houston Kayak and Paddleboard Rentals
@graph.description: Self-guided kayak and stand-up paddleboard rentals on Buffalo Bayou in downtown Houston. Choose from single kayaks, tandem kayaks, or paddleboards for 1 hour, 2 hours, or a full day. No experience required. Launch from 1019 Commerce Street.

offers.name: Single Kayak or Paddleboard - Full Day

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to rent a kayak in Houston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Single kayak or paddleboard rentals start at $20 for one hour or $40 for two hours. Tandem kayaks are $35 for one hour or $65 for two hours. Full-day rentals are available starting at $55 for a single and $85 for a tandem.

mainEntity.name: Where do I pick up my kayak rental in Houston?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rentals launch from 1019 Commerce Street in downtown Houston, next to Talento Bilingue. Reservations are recommended to guarantee equipment availability, especially on weekends.

mainEntity.name: Do I need experience to rent a kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: No prior experience is required. Staff will give you a quick orientation on paddling and safety before you head out. All renters must sign a waiver, and minors must have a guardian sign on their behalf.

mainEntity.name: What ID do I need to rent a kayak?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will need a valid photo ID and a credit card at time of pickup. All renters must complete a signed waiver before launching.
